macros.name: blockmargin
macros.doc: The easiest way to block off part of the margin is to call \blockmargin before the extended content and \unblockmargin afterwards.

macros.name: blockmargin
macros.doc: The easiest way to block off part of the margin is to call \blockmargin before the extended content and \unblockmargin afterwards.

macros.name: clearmargin
macros.doc: In an analog to \clearpage, \clearmargin prevents any further material from being added to the current margin.

macros.name: marginphantom
macros.doc: The \marginphantom command is basically just a concatenation of \blockmargin and \unblockmargin.

macros.name: marginphantom
macros.doc: The \marginphantom command is basically just a concatenation of \blockmargin and \unblockmargin.

macros.name: marginskip
macros.doc: Calling \marginskip{⟨length⟩} will insert an incompressible skip in the margin.

macros.name: mparshift
macros.doc: To adjust the position of a single note, use \mparshift{⟨length⟩} before a call to \marginpar.

macros.name: unblockmargin
macros.doc: Each of these commands takes an optional argument: \blockmargin[⟨pos⟩] will begin the margin block at a position pos below the current position (or above if pos is negative), and \unblockmargin[⟨pos⟩] will likewise end the block at a position pos below the current position.
